'''Robert D. Gibbons''' is a professor in the field of [[statistics]], with expertise in [[biostatistics]], [[environmental statistics]], and [[psychometrics]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Robert D. Gibbons |url=https://www.cornerstone.com/experts/robert-gibbons/ |access-date=2024-02-06 |website=Cornerstone Research |language=en-US}}</ref> He holds the position of Blum-Riese Professor and Pritzker Scholar at the [[University of Chicago]], with appointments in the Departments of Medicine,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Robert Gibbons {{!}} Profiles RNS |url=https://profiles.uchicago.edu/profiles/display/38559 |access-date=2024-02-05 |website=profiles.uchicago.edu}}</ref> Public Health Sciences (Biostatistics),<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title={{!}} Public Health Sciences {{!}} The University of Chicago |url=https://pbhs.uchicago.edu/faculty/robert-gibbons-phd |access-date=2024-02-05 |website=pbhs.uchicago.edu |language=en}}</ref> and Comparative Human Development.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Robert Gibbons {{!}} Department of Comparative Human Development |url=https://humdev.uchicago.edu/directory/Robert-Gibbons |access-date=2024-02-05 |website=humdev.uchicago.edu}}</ref> Gibbons is a Fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]], the [[International Statistical Institute]], and the [[Royal Statistical Society]], and a member of the [[National Academy of Medicine]] of the [[National Academy of Sciences]]. He has made contributions to statistical work spanning areas such as longitudinal data analysis, [[item response theory]], environmental statistics, and drug safety, with over 350 [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] scientific papers<ref>{{Cite web |title=Robert D. Gibbons |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=jkK_OWsAAAAJ&hl=en |access-date=2024-02-05 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref> and several books<ref>{{Cite web |title=Item Response Theory {{!}} Wiley |url=https://www.wiley.com/en-in/Item+Response+Theory-p-9781119716686 |access-date=2024-02-05 |website=Wiley.com |language=en-in}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Longitudinal Data Analysis {{!}} Wiley |url=https://www.wiley.com/en-us/Longitudinal+Data+Analysis-p-9780471420279 |access-date=2024-02-05 |website=Wiley.com |language=en-us}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Statistical Methods for Groundwater Monitoring, 2nd Edition {{!}} Wiley |url=https://www.wiley.com/en-us/Statistical+Methods+for+Groundwater+Monitoring%2C+2nd+Edition-p-9780470549933 |access-date=2024-02-05 |website=Wiley.com |language=en-us}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Amatya |first=Robert D. Gibbons, Anup |url=https://www.taylorfrancis.com/books/mono/10.1201/b18698/statistical-methods-drug-safety-robert-gibbons-anup-amatya |title=Statistical Methods for Drug Safety |date=2015-07-23 |publisher=Chapman and Hall/CRC |isbn=978-0-429-09968-7 |location=New York |doi=10.1201/b18698}}</ref> to his name.

== Education ==
* Ph.D. (Statistics and Psychometrics), University of Chicago, 1981
* B.A. (Chemistry and Mathematics), [[University of Denver]], 1976
